caseNameFull: Baltimore & Ohio Railroad Company v. Louis Block
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of Appeals of the State of Virginia.
attorneys: Mr. Rudolph1 Bumgardner for plaintiffs in error. Mr. V. R. Shackel-ford for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.
